text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you come into the land you are to inhabit, which I am giving you,
text_cn: “你吩咐以色列子民说：你们进入了我赐给你们居住的地方时，

text_en: and you make an offering by fire to the Lord from the herd or from the flock—whether a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering or at your appointed festivals—to make a pleasing odor for the Lord ,
text_cn: 如要以牛或羊献给上主作火祭，或作全燔祭，或作任何祭献，或为还愿，或出于自愿，或因逢节期，以之作为悦乐上主的馨香祭，

text_en: then whoever presents such an offering to the Lord shall present also a grain offering, one-tenth of an ephah of choice flour, mixed with one-fourth of a hin of oil.
text_cn: 献祭的人应给上主加献十分之一‘厄法’细面，调和四分之一‘辛’油，作为素祭。

text_en: Moreover, you shall offer one-fourth of a hin of wine as a drink offering with the burnt offering or the sacrifice, for each lamb.
text_cn: 此外，为全燔祭或为任何祭献，还应奠上酒：为每只公羔羊，奠四分之一‘辛’酒。

text_en: For a ram, you shall offer a grain offering, two-tenths of an ephah of choice flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil;
text_cn: 如果是只公绵羊，应加献十分之二‘厄法’细面，调和上三分之一‘辛’油，作为素祭；

text_en: and as a drink offering you shall offer one-third of a hin of wine, a pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 再奠上三分之一‘辛’酒，作为悦乐上主的馨香祭。

text_en: When you offer a bull as a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as an offering of well-being to the Lord ,
text_cn: 如果你以一只牛犊献作全燔祭或任何祭献，或为还愿，或献与上主作和平祭，

text_en: then you shall present with the bull a grain offering, three-tenths of an ephah of choice flour, mixed with half a hin of oil,
text_cn: 除牛犊外，还应加献十分之三‘厄法’细面，调和上半‘辛’油，作为素祭；

text_en: and you shall present as a drink offering half a hin of wine, as an offering by fire, a pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 再奠上半‘辛’酒，作为悦乐上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: Thus it shall be done for each ox or ram, or for each of the male lambs or the kids.
text_cn: 每献一头公牛，或一只公绵羊，或一只公羔羊，或一只公山羊，都应照此而行；

text_en: According to the number that you offer, so you shall do with each and every one.
text_cn: 你们所献的数目无论多少，为每一只都应照此而行。

text_en: Every native Israelite shall do these things in this way, in presenting an offering by fire, a pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 本地人不论谁，献悦乐上主的馨香火祭时，都应这样行。

text_en: An alien who lives with you, or who takes up permanent residence among you, and wishes to offer an offering by fire, a pleasing odor to the Lord , shall do as you do.
text_cn: 几时一个与你们同住的，或与你们的后代同住的外方人，愿献悦乐上主的馨香火祭，你们怎样行，他也应怎样行。

text_en: As for the assembly, there shall be for both you and the resident alien a single statute, a perpetual statute throughout your generations; you and the alien shall be alike before the Lord .
text_cn: 全会众，不论是为你们，或为与你们同住的外方人，只有一样的规定；这为你们世世代代，是一永远的规定：在上主面前你们与外方人一样；

text_en: You and the alien who resides with you shall have the same law and the same ordinance.
text_cn: 为你们和与你们同住的外方人，只有一种法律，只有一种制度。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: After you come into the land to which I am bringing you,
text_cn: “你吩咐以色列子民说：几时你们进入了我引你们去的地方，

text_en: whenever you eat of the bread of the land, you shall present a donation to the Lord .
text_cn: 吃那地方的食粮时，应拿一分献给上主作礼品：

text_en: From your first batch of dough you shall present a loaf as a donation; you shall present it just as you present a donation from the threshing floor.
text_cn: 由初熟的麦面团中，献一个饼作礼品，有如奉献才从禾场打下之物一样。

text_en: Throughout your generations you shall give to the Lord a donation from the first of your batch of dough.
text_cn: 你们世世代代，应从初熟麦面团中取出，献给上主作礼品。

text_en: But if you unintentionally fail to observe all these commandments that the Lord has spoken to Moses—
text_cn: 如果你们误犯了过失，而没有遵行上主向梅瑟所吩咐的某条诫命，

text_en: everything that the Lord has commanded you by Moses, from the day the Lord gave commandment and thereafter, throughout your generations—
text_cn: 即上主藉梅瑟向你们所吩咐的，由上主出命之日起，直到你们世世代代，

text_en: then if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation, the whole congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, a pleasing odor to the Lord , together with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
text_cn: 那么，如果是会众出于无心误犯了过失，全会众应献一公牛犊当全燔祭，作为悦乐上主的馨香祭，并依照礼规献素祭和奠酒礼，再献一公山羊作赎罪祭。

text_en: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the Israelites, and they shall be forgiven; it was unintentional, and they have brought their offering, an offering by fire to the Lord , and their sin offering before the Lord , for their error.
text_cn: 司祭应为以色列子民全会众行赎罪礼，他们即可获得赦免，因为这是无心之过。当他们为这无心之过，给上主奉献了火祭，并在上主面前献了赎罪祭后，

text_en: All the congregation of the Israelites shall be forgiven, as well as the aliens residing among them, because the whole people was involved in the error.
text_cn: 以色列子民全会众以及住在你们中的外方人，都获得赦免，因为全人民犯了无心之过。

text_en: An individual who sins unintentionally shall present a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
text_cn: 如果是一人出于无心犯了罪，应献一只一岁的母山羊作赎罪祭。

text_en: And the priest shall make atonement before the Lord for the one who commits an error, when it is unintentional, to make atonement for the person, who then shall be forgiven.
text_cn: 司祭为这犯无心之过的人，在上主面前行赎罪礼，因为他由于无心犯了罪；为他行了赎罪礼，他即可获得赦免。

text_en: For both the native among the Israelites and the alien residing among them—you shall have the same law for anyone who acts in error.
text_cn: 凡以色列子民，不拘是本地人或住在你们中的外方人，对误犯过失的人，只有一条法律。

text_en: But whoever acts high-handedly, whether a native or an alien, affronts the Lord , and shall be cut off from among the people.
text_cn: 但如果一人，不论是本地人，或是外方人，敢大胆妄为，侮辱上主，这人应由民间铲除；

text_en: Because of having despised the word of the Lord and broken his commandment, such a person shall be utterly cut off and bear the guilt.
text_cn: 因为他轻视了上主的话，违犯了他的诫命，这人应被除灭，应自负罪债。”

text_en: When the Israelites were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the sabbath day.
text_cn: 以色列子民尚在旷野的时候，遇见一人在安息日拾柴，

text_en: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses, Aaron, and to the whole congregation.
text_cn: 遇见他拾柴的人，就带他到梅瑟及亚郎和全会众前；

text_en: They put him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.
text_cn: 他们将他押在看守所内，因为尚未指明应如何处置他。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses, “The man shall be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him outside the camp. ”
text_cn: 那时上主对梅瑟说：“这人应处死刑，全会众应在营外用石头将他砸死。”

text_en: The whole congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him to death, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 全会众遂拉他到营外，用石头砸死他，照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: The Lord said to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the Israelites, and tell them to make fringes on the corners of their garments throughout their generations and to put a blue cord on the fringe at each corner.
text_cn: “你吩咐以色列子民，命他们世世代代，在自己衣边上做上穗头，衣边的每个穗头，应用紫绳系着。

text_en: You have the fringe so that, when you see it, you will remember all the commandments of the Lord and do them, and not follow the lust of your own heart and your own eyes.
text_cn: 这穗头是为叫你们一看见，就想起上主的诫命，依照遵行，免得你们随从心中和眼目的欲望，而放纵淫乱。

text_en: So you shall remember and do all my commandments, and you shall be holy to your God.
text_cn: 这样，你们必对我的一切诫命，怀念不忘，依照遵行；这样在你们的天主面前，你们常是圣洁的。

text_en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 我上主是你们的天主，我领你们出离埃及是为作你们的天主：我上主是你们的天主。”
